sources.title: Agentic Search for Guides and Answers - Kimi Help Center
sources.snippet: Agentic search Kimi's Agentic Search is built on an end-to-end agentic reinforcement learning architecture. Unlike traditional tool-orchestration approaches, it lets the AI autonomously decide when to search, which tools to invoke, and how to adjust strategy — enabling complex information gathering and processing tasks.
